sampling: proportional stratified visual preview, without replacement; no model predictions used
fingerprint: 2048 Morgan count product block + 2048 product-minus-reactants Morgan count block; radius 2; separate L2 normalization then joint L2 normalization
duplicate_node_policy: Exact product/difference count fingerprints merged; all selected records represented by node multiplicity; dominant family is colour metadata
bridge_method: MST on component-mean cosine distances selects component pairs; exact nearest fingerprint pair for each bridge
tree_method: minimum spanning tree of the augmented symmetric exact kNN graph
method_identity: Custom Morgan-based similarity tree; not rxnfp, not a reproduction of the TMAP software layout
